nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Intense 72H Lipid-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer

avis.texte: I am 63 and live in a dry climate. This is a fantastic moisturizer. It is actually repairing my skin. Expensive yet worth it.

This has been in my arsenal practically since it launched and I'm specifically referring to the 72 hour formula. It's different than the 100 hour formula, which I don't love. The 72 hour formula is so lightweight yet extremely hydrating. Almost a jelly formula? Works beautifully under makeup also without any pilling. I can't tell you how many jars of this I have gone through.
Love Clinique moisturizer, not oily. I will most definitely buy this product again and again.
Expensive, but worth it. As my everyday moisturizer under makeup, this product produces value and quality for the price.
I am obsessed with this cream. I use it daily when I wake up and makes my dry skin feel so hydrated. It's my favorite Clinique product!

I am suffering from small spots on my face because of dryness in north america weather and my mom gave me this to try. It's not sticky and at least didn't get me worse. Then I go online to buy this and the mask. I love the overnight mask and that's a game changer. Pair this with the mask and dryness goes away.
They lied to us saying if you buy a 50ml moisture surge they would give you a free 50ml instead they gave me 2 bottle of 30 ml disguise as if they were 50ml

avis.titre: Super moisturizing for very dry skin
avis.texte: Love this moisturizer for very dry skin. Doesn't pill under my foundation or concealer and doesn't irritate my eyes like so many others do. I had to switch from my old favorite as they added sunscreen and it became irritant. This stuff is great and keeps moisture in.
I use this everyday as part of my morning routine. It's a good moisturizer and leaves my skin feeling great all day. Works really well before SPF and tinted cream.

avis.titre: I will definitely be purchasing this product again
avis.texte: My Sister told me about this product and it's everything and more of what she said, I love it and my face does also

avis.titre: Been a Clinique user for years
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cream, i use all clinique prducts and will never stop. This face cream leaves my skin feeling hydrated.

What happened to Clinique products being clean and healthy for your skin? I didn't read the ingredients until I got home and discovered this is full of silicone junk. It made my skin break out and I will have to rerun it.

avis.titre: 72 Hr Formula Best for Menopausal Skin!
avis.texte: This is highly moisturizing and soothing, would definitely recommend this specific formula for super dry and/or sensitized skin.

avis.titre: Stings, burns, and my skin is flaking
avis.texte: So disappointed with this product. It's burning and stinging around my eye area, my skin is flaking around my eyelids. The area burns so bad, I can't wear makeup over it. Going back to confidence in a cream by it cosmetics. I'm done with Clinique.
Moisture Surge Intense is super creamy and soft on your skin. Feels wonderful like you are getting a facelift. Would recommend it for moisturizing your skin on a daily basis.
My skin doesn't like anything else. This is my favorite go to especially with sensitive skin!

I absolutely love this product, however take in mind this is in my opinion for extremely dry skin (like mine). It's wonderful, it's super creamy, super thick, it melts on your skin and makes any product that goes afterward feel smooth and easy to apply. This makes my foundation look super natural because of how it makes it glide. Btw I have both this 72h cream and the 100h gel. I use this 72h when I want my super dry skin to look precious, but I still use my 100h gel when it's really hot and I don't want something as heavy. I love both for different reasons and I will buying both
I use it along with redness solution cream as I have a very dry skin redness cream alone is not enough for my skin. I also like a creamy texture of it.

avis.titre: Love this product for the winter time
avis.texte: I use this during the drying winter months. It keeps my skin well hydrated.
I live in high mountain desert. This moisturizer really delivers! Also not irritating for sensitive skin, helps my makeup to go on better as well - bonus!

avis.titre: The only moisturizer my skin likes
avis.texte: This has been my go to for years and I recommend it to everyone. My skin is so sensitive it doesn't like anything else so it's worth the money. Plus I look younger than my age. I'm 31 and regularly get mistaken as anywhere from 18-25.
I have used this product for years and ive always been happy with it.
Best winter lotion ever!! Keeps my skin smooth and hydrated!!!

I usually use the more expensive creams from Clinique because I have very dry skin. I got a free 1 oz jar of this and I love it ! I bought the big jar and I'm almost out of it and I will repurchase. This stuff is amazing.
i love it sm its the only moisturizer i use it makes my skin so dewy and soft 1000/10 would reccomend (if you have moderately dry skin like me)

avis.titre: I have been using this since 2013!!!
avis.texte: The best product for Very dry or dry + Combination skin. I will purchase this forever. I have been using it since I was 13. I am now 26 and I will continue buying this product. I have eczema and wear this product before applying any makeup. My Chin and cheeks usually peel but with this product I am always hydrated under my makeup. I found that the 72h moisture intense works best for people with very dry skin and have eczema. I have an oily nose and sometimes forehead at times and it works all the same. Thank you Clinique for your amazing product. You have forever restored my skin!

I've tried many moisturizers for my dry/combo skin and find myself coming back to this one over and over. It's so expensive but hydrates deeply and doesn't dry up after application. My skin actually feels softer and not like I'm just applying oil on top or adding water that dries immediately. If gel moisturizers aren't enough for you but you don't want to feel like there's a layer of oil on your face I definitely recommend.
Received a coupon so went to Ulta to use on product don't normally go there

I have tried the 100h and all other options. Including other brands. The 72h is still the only one that can keep my skin moisturized and prevent breakouts, or giving me the fresh young skin look! I don't know what I would do without it.
This is the only face cream that is hydrating enough for winter time.
I have eczema and I used this cream it cleared up my face and no itchiness now. I tried everything before. This is a miracle cream for me.
Over years I've used moisture surge products from Clinique but this was first time to try the intense. It really works for me.

I love this moisturizer! It really does what it claims. I use this on top of my Dramatically Different mousturizer plus for dry skin. I'm 59 years old and Plan to keep using this wonderful moisturizer.
Great customer service and would recommend this to anyone with dry skin.
Dry, sensitive skin here — this works really well for my skin, especially at my age. It's gentle and keeps me hydrated for a long time.

I don't understand the low rarings of this product! I have very dry skin and I've struggled to find a Clinique moisturizer that will adequately treat it. I tired this one on a whim and it works great! I love Clinique because the ingrediants are dependable and effective. I love this moisturizer and I'll continue to buy it!

I have oily skin but also dry patches. I have tried many moisturizers over the years and this is BY FAR THE BEST!! This is also great for use after having a facial peel. I would highly recommend this and hope Clinique doesn't stop making it!

I've been using this for over 5 years. Works great in super dry high altitudes. I used to live in Denver, and this works well. Yes, it feels a little sticky at first, but very light. It speaks in and makes my skin feel great.

I have used moisture surge for a few years. I decided to try the intense and wow! I love it. I use the intense at night and the regular moisture surge during the day. This routine has helped keep my dry skin feeling moisturized and plump. Definitely recommend!

The ONLY moisturizer my skin actually likes. I'm very eczema prone and have super dry skin. This is my repeat go to because it helps me feel like me again! I legit don't know what I'd do if this moisturizer changed or was gone.
Been using Moisture Surge Intense for over ten years. Introduced to my teenager who now asks that I buy for her, too!

This is the only product that adequately relieves dryness and tightness on my face. I use it night and day. I can use it with my Clindamycin Phosphate and Tretinoin Gel 1.2%/0.025% (which I only use at night). Almost any other moisturizer I've tried hasn't reacted well with the that gel.

avis.titre: The absolute best for sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin is chronically dry, flaky, and sensitive. This is the ONLY moisturizer that works for me. My favorite clinique product ever.
feels great on my dry skin, prices went up, but it is a good product.

Moisturizing and not irritating. For people with rosacea works great especially after shower or face wash when my face cools off and gets dry. I like the cream/gel consistency. Don't ever stop producing this cream.
I'm 64 years old and this Clinique Moisture Surge is the best.

This product is perfect for my skin. My skin feels moisturized all day . My skin is sensitive and some moisturizers actually make my skin breakout, this does not. I also appreciate that it isn't scented. I highly recommend this product .

Ok, so I will admit I have not used Clinique since I was a teenager in the late 90s. It has always seemed to be too pricey compared to drug store skin care products that I started using as I got older. Nowadays, I am a big fan of Origins, Belif, and Cosrx , plus a few other Korean brands that I can't live without. I wanted to get a free gift bag from Clinique and bought this on a whim. I am so glad I did ! I have very dry skin and this is such a beautifully thick and luxury moisturizer. It is better than anything I've ever tried. I would buy this again and again! A little goes a long way, so you don't have to use a lot when you do.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: This product only keeps moisture for a few once dry there's no moisture
I've been using moisture surge for several years now. It gives my skin just the right amount of hydration without feeling heavy on my skin. Definitely a must have for the fall/winter months.
I have really dry skin and certain products had started making my skin peel, replaced my moisturizer with this and no more problems

I have combination skin that needs hydrating and moisturizing. I wasn't too sure how heavy this would feel given the ingredients, but, it is heavenly. I've tried the 100 hr moisture surge and didn't care for it, but, this intense is really great. No breaking out or pilling either. Just nice soft skin. I bought the smaller size to try it first and a little amount goes a long way.

avis.titre: will buy again extremely dry skin
avis.texte: I've used this for 7 days, morning and night. It is helping with my chin are being so dry it peels in the morning
I recently started getting eczema on my face. This moisturizer cleared it up on the first application!

This was used on me when i got my makeup done for my wedding, which came out beautifully and wasnt charged an arm and a leg. Been buying and using it every single day since the day i was introduced to it. Love this product, cant live without it.

avis.titre: Fantastic moisturizer for very dry skin!
avis.texte: Ive been using this Moisture Surge Intense for quite awhile now. I use it just on the dry patches on my face. It works so well and does its job. I also use the regular Moisture Surge for my whole face. If you are on the fence about this Intense version, try a small jar and you will love it.

avis.titre: Sent me wrong item, supposed to be the Pink Gel Moisture sur
avis.texte: Ordered the pink gel Moisture Surge got wrong item. White creme moisture surge was sent.

I love how this just melts into my skin. I have mature skin I am 57 years old and love this moisturizer. A little goes a long way. This makes my face feel so hydrated and works well for night time skin care as well as my morning routine and under my makeup.

I purchased the 4.2 oz size and its huge, definitely more bang for your buck! This is the only thing thats come close to keeping my skin as hydrated as the Tatcha dewy skin cream. Not saying its a dupe but comes pretty close
I love the product so much it makes my skin so soft and moisturized however the 0.5 size is so small and I don't think it's worth the money great product Clinique but maybe make it a little bigger.
I buy this moisturizer every summer. It's lighter than my winter go-to, but keeps my face just right the rest of the year.

avis.titre: The only thing that works on my dry sensitive skin!
avis.texte: This is my number one must have in my skincare routine and I've been using it for years. The best moisturizer I've ever used! It's the only thing that actually moisturizes all year round and doesn't bother my sensitive skin.

I love this moisturizer. I tried the original 100h and it was okay but didn't really work for my normal to dry skin. I bought this last month and I just love it. I wash my face and while still slightly damp, apply the moisturizer. It doesn't take much and it sinks right in without feeling greasy. I have sensitive skin and no breakouts or rash with this product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I'm delighted with this product. I currently have mild rosacea, and my skin felt flaky and dry. After using this product my skin looks calm hydrated, and very soft. Of all the lines I've used this is definitely my favorite.

My skin was so dry it was painful. This saved my face! I do not have any sensitivity or breakout issues, neither before or after use. My skin was just parched and nothing was working, but this! I highly recommend if you have extremely dry skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This is the only product that I've found to keep my VERY dry skin moisturized all day. Pricey, but it works for me so I will buy again.

I've been using Moisture Surge Intense for over 5 years now. I have very dry skin due to an auto immune and this has been the only moisturizer on the market that I have found that actually moisturizes my skin. It not only gives my skin a beautiful, dewy, and hydrated look/feel, but it also blends well with most of my foundation.

avis.titre: Defintely going to be a repurchase!!
avis.texte: I have mature skin and have been looking for something that was good for super dry skin and this has been great!

This product saved my life!!! I'm going through menopause and my skin changed big time! It turned into skin dryer then the Mojave desert! Nothing was working anymore & my makeup looked terrible until I found this MIRACLE IN A JAR!!! It saved my skin and I was able to be confident wearing my makeup again!!! Please do not stop making this!!! If you are a menopausal woman with extremely dry skin try this product!! It will save your life!! It's also amazing on my dry winter hands too!
I absolutely love this moisturizer it's not to heavy but very hydrating.
I like this product it's not too heavy and feel moisturizing. . But it burns on some parts of my face. It's been about 30 minutes and still burning. :/ I wish it didn't! I like the feel a lot.

avis.titre: Makes my skin acne and itchy
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this moisturizer, but unfortunately, it didn't work well for my skin. After using it, I noticed that I developed acne and my skin became itchy. It wasn't the right fit for me, and I was disappointed with the results. I would recommend doing a patch test before using it.

This is my favorite face cream. I have sensitive skin, and Clinique moisture surge intense did not cause any irritation. I used to have very dry, tight skin before using. It is a rich cream, so I like applying at night before going to bed since it doesn't absorb as quickly and leaves your skin looking shiny for a while, that way it has all night to work it's magic. If I need a little bit of moisturizer before applying makeup, I use the regular Clinique Moisture Surge which does absorb quickly. I used to have a dry patch of skin next to my mouth/chin that would peel constantly, nothing helped. Once I started using this Clinique moisture surge intense, it completely healed and disappeared without a trace, within a couple of weeks. Would recommend to anyone with dry skin.

I'm a proponent of Men having a skin care routine. 72H is great for the Winter months (100H is used exclusively the rest of the year). Since my skin is rough I appreciate the thicker formula because it keeps my skin moisturized all day yet doesn't make my skin look oily . Great product.
I struggled for YEARS as an adult with dry, irritated and pimply skin, trying countless products. Once I started using this moisturizer, all of my problems went away. I'll never use anything else!

Not worth the buy, you can find other or better moisturizers that fit your skin type with better results. Targets older ladies who don't want to spend time looking around for a cheaper better product. NEXT!

I was recommended this by a Clinique Professional for my dry, flaky skin around my mouth area and it has not helped at all after about 2 weeks of use. I use it twice a day as recommended. I've also been using a Clinique facial cleanser and lotion for "dry skin" for several months now, but I'm starting to think Clinique is just too harsh for my sensitive, dry skin as I've never had this problem before and the winter has made it much worse. My old cleanser and lotion that I had been using for years without any issues got discontinued so that's why I've been trying Clinique.

My skin literally won't accept anything other than this moisturizer! I have extremely sensitive, eczema prone skin and this stuff is incredible. 10 out of 10 I don't buy any other moisturizer than this. My skin is toast without this product. LOVE.
I switch between the MS Intense 72hr for winter and the MS 100Hr for summer. Perfect products, I love them both!
Not sure what exactly is different between this and the moisture surge 100h but this product is heavy and burns my skin...i wanted to love it!

It soaks in but also feels like it's adding a moisture barrier. It moisturizes and plumps. I haven't tried more expensive products comparable to this but I tried ones at the same price; I will always come back to moisture surge. I don't think there is a comparable product that isn't extremely more expensive.
I finally a found a moisturizer that absorbs perfect for my dry skin, this stuff is magic in a small bottle, I applied in the AM and my face felt quenched all day, this will be my go to from now on.

I absolutely love this moisturizer. I got this one by mistake a few yrs ago (the containers all lool the same) but im so glad i did! I have combination skin, very oily but dry around my mouth and chin. This evened my skin tone while healing the dry skin. I also noticed much fewer breakouts. I only use this as part of my night routine.
Read the ingredients list. Ladies this product has BHT in it! An endocrine disrupter. Another company putting bad chemicals in our products. I've been using for 30 years. That's just great.

I absolutely love this product! My skin stays supple all day. I've used the 100-hour moisture gel, and I would have to couple it with a face serum. I felt it only worked best for gripping makeup. This is so worth the price, as a little goes a long way.

I use this daily and find it to work well. It's not greasy, which I really like. Your skin feels dewy even the next day. My daughter and DIL are obsessed, so their Christmas stockings always contain a large jar!
I have worn clinique products for 30 years. I need a really good moisturizer and this is not it. Very greasy and cauae me to have bad breakouts
Please be awarw this contains whey. I have an anaphylactic dairy allergy and ended with hives all over my face

avis.titre: Post Menopausal Skin Hack by Clinique
avis.texte: Moisture Surge Intense is the BEST moisturizer for addressing my post hysterectomy skin issues. It plumps and refines my dry thirsty skin to deeper layers. I use it AM and PM. It works well under daily make up, and doesn't get on to my pillow at night. Versatile!!!

I have roseacea and I hoped this cream woukd be a great daily before make cream. After two daya of use my face became inflamed/hot to the touch along with a rash. Not sure what ingrediant could cause this but bringing it back.

Purchased on line with free shipping. When I opened the package I received Clinique blush instead of Clinique Moisture Surge Intense. Very disappointed. Had to make a trip to the store to exchange. I order on line to avoid traffic etc. I like the moisture surge intense it is the best I have found. Hope the next time I order I receive the correct item. Everyone makes mistakes...it is what it is.

I wrecked my moisture barrier (probably from overexfoliating) and had been suffering for weeks with raw, flaky skin around my mouth and chin. Nothing helped, everything seemed to irritate it, even my Clinique DDMG. I tried the travel size of this on a whim, and not only did it not irritate my fragile skin, it actually repaired it in a couple days, no more rawness or flakes. I immediately purchased the biggest size Ulta sold. This is a holy grail for me!

I'm 80 in two weeks and because of breast cancer 2 years ago and having to take a medication that gets rid of ALL hormones, because my can er was driven by estrogen and progesterone, I am bone dry. This is the only thing that works for my face and keeps me moisturized for more than 24 hours!
Ive been ising this foe swveral years, its my favorite part of my mornings. It is so soothing and you can feel the moisture it is providing to my face, neck and chest

I used to live in CA and rarely used any sort of moisture. That changed when i moved CO. This moisturizer keeps my skin soft, but it isnt greasy and doesnt break me out. Im currently on my 8th or 9th jar and I will mever not use it.

Very sticky product. Doesn't seep into skin at all. It sits as a thick layer on your skin. I feel like it's basically pointless to use. Very disappointed in this purchase. I feel like all the reviews are lies.

After suffering from combination/oily skin my whole life, the late 40's brought me combination/dry skin instead. I got this moisturizer ahead of a trip to Chicago in the middle of winter and it did it's job well! My skin never got dry or red or chapped, and I've kept using it after returning home to the swampy, steamy south with great results. It hydrates my skin and most people think I'm a decade younger than I am because my skin is so smooth and healthy looking. My routine is the Take the Day Off Cleansing Balm, followed by the All About Clean Rinse Off Foaming Cleanser, and finished up with the Moisture Surge Intense 72 Hour Lipid-Replenishing hydrator. It's a simple routine that works great.

Since I turned 55, my skin has been drier than the Mojave desert! Nothing was working on my dry skin anymore and my makeup looked terrible. The girl at the Clinique counter recommended this moisturizer. It saved my life! It is intensely moisturizing and makes my makeup go on very smooth. This moisturizer is amazing!! Clinique, please do not stop making this product! A must for dry mature skin!

avis.titre: A Great Boost for my elderly, dry skin.
avis.texte: I found my face and neck skin was becoming much more dry than ever before. I am 73 and had oily/combination skin most of my life. Recently that has been changing. Clinique's Moisture Surge Intense has been the answer to my problem.
I've got extremely sensitive skin and this is the only thing that keeps my skin nice. It's hydrating, healing, and seems great on eczema prone skin. It's so worth it.

This used to be the best, most moisturizing product out there. I purchased for years. This new formula is awful. "Intense"? Ha! More like moisturizer Light. It's so bad. I hope you will bring back the old formula. As I will now be searching for a new product and wasting money.

I never write reviews. It usually doesn't occur to me, especially if I'm satisfied with a purchase. In this case, however, I have to talk about my experience. It was just that good. I've been struggling with red, very dry skin with a lot of texture. This is really uncommon for me, and I wasn't sure what to do. I tried a few creams and serums and everything felt so superficial with no real change. I've been using this product now for about a week, and my skin is entirely different. My skin feels smoother, the redness is gone and it feels plump and bouncy. My skin just feels replenished, and I'm sincerely so impressed with this product. If you're dealing with very dry skin, I highly, highly recommend this.
